name: chess
description: Play chess in the conversation on a real interactive board, against the built-in Stockfish engine, against the model itself, or live against other people in a shared lobby. Bundles the chess-coaching skill + the hosted chess MCP server (chess.maxhealth.tech), which also analyses finished games and any public chess.com or Lichess player's recent games.

interface.shortDescription: Play chess on a real board, then have the game explained.
interface.longDescription: An interactive chess board in the conversation. Play the built-in Stockfish at one of six levels, play the model itself, or join a shared lobby and play live against other people. Afterwards the engine analyses the game (accuracy, the moves that turned it, the better move you missed), and the assistant explains it in plain language. It can also study any public chess.com or Lichess player's recent games by handle.
